recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒邊緣有數個巨核細胞，細胞質豐富，但核呈單葉或僅輕度凹陷的卵圓形，缺乏正常的多葉核；周圍造血細胞稀少、以紅血球為主，符合 Emberger syndrome（GATA2 缺乏症）低細胞骨髓合併巨核細胞發育不良。
features: Cluster of megakaryocytes at the edge of a marrow particle with abundant pale granular cytoplasm
Hypolobated nuclei: single oval or slightly indented (monolobated to bilobed) nuclei instead of multilobation
Nuclear size small relative to the abundant cytoplasm
Sparse accompanying hematopoietic precursors; scattered small lymphocytes only
Background of abundant red cells, consistent with a paucicellular aspirate
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a marrow particle edge containing a cluster of megakaryocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm but abnormally hypolobated nuclei, several being single oval or minimally indented nuclei rather than the normal multilobated form. Surrounding hematopoietic precursors are sparse, with scattered small lymphocytes in a background dominated by red cells, in keeping with a hypocellular marrow. Blasts are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia in a hypocellular marrow, as seen in GATA2 deficiency (Emberger syndrome); correlation with biopsy, blast enumeration, and cytogenetics is needed to establish hypocellular MDS.

ddx.vs: Also has hypolobated megakaryocytes but in a normo- or hypercellular marrow with thrombocytosis; defined by del(5q) on karyotype.
Aplastic anemia marrow has few or absent megakaryocytes without dysplastic hypolobation; significant megakaryocytic dysplasia argues for MDS.
CML megakaryocytes are small hypolobated 'dwarf' forms in a markedly hypercellular granulocytic marrow with BCR::ABL1, unlike this paucicellular aspirate.

ddx.dx: Normal megakaryocytes cut or smeared obliquely
ddx.vs: Normal megakaryocytes show a contiguous multilobated nucleus proportional to cytoplasm; multiple cells with consistently round single nuclei indicate true dysplasia.
